pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Sandworm Nest.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The worm has separate segments. A damaged segment receives 30% more initial damage; subsequent defenses still apply. Hitting it can trigger a retaliatory spit. Focus a damaged segment, then change position after attacking. JEM scales the segment-damage threshold with maximum health.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Sirok Gauntlet. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Black Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory. Reward: 300 XP.
